act_title: The Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest Act, 2002
title: Protection of action taken in good faith
text:
32. Protection of action taken in good faith.—No suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall

lie against [the Reserve Bank or the Central Registry or any secured creditor or any of its officers] for
anything done or omitted to be done in good faith under this Act.
